name: @letbuyy/lcis-twin
description: LDTS — Dependency Twin System. Read-only enterprise dependency intelligence: a unified typed twin (feature→page→api→rpc→worker→queue→cron→database→table→trigger→storage→deployment→infrastructure→test→documentation) composed from the structural artifacts, six graph views, and pure deterministic algorithms (shortest path, critical path, cycles, SPOF, fan-in/out, impact radius). Never mutates; runtime edge weights are honestly NOT_CONNECTED.
